posts.title: Nobody reads your changelog
posts.subtitle: Contrarian take · text + first comment
posts.content:
Nobody reads your changelog.

They read the diff of their own broken build.

We spent a year writing careful release notes.
Version numbers.
Migration guides.
Neat little bullet points.

Then we watched the support tickets.

Not one person had read any of it.
posts.first_comment: The fix that worked for us: put the breaking change in the error message itself, not the docs.

posts.title: The demo that failed on purpose
posts.subtitle: Founder narrative · from interview transcript
posts.content:
I once shipped a demo that failed on purpose.

It showed the error screen first.
Then the recovery.

Because that was the honest pitch.

Every tool looks great when nothing breaks.
posts.first_comment: Buyers trust the recovery story more than the happy path.
